docs.title: Francesa Sarah of Safed
docs.text: Francesa Sarah of Safed Francesa Sarah (16th-century), was a Jewish mystic. She is described in the "Sefer ha-Ḥezyonot" ("The Book of Visions") by Hayyim Vital. She was a holy woman in the early Sabbateanism in Safed, and unique in Jewish religious history as the only woman regarded to have had a "maggidim", an angelic spirit with the ability to foretell the future. A "maggidim" was, in accordance with belief, granted only to very select few among the highest scholars, and she was the only woman credited such. She is depicted as extremely wise and righteous, and made several famed prophesies.

docs.title: Frau Farbissina
docs.text: Frau Farbissina Frau Farbissina ("Frau Kaput" in Spain), is a fictional character played by Mindy Sterling in the "Austin Powers" film series. Farbissina is a German attack and defence specialist and the founder of "the militant wing of the Salvation Army". She is also Dr. Evil's henchwoman and tries to help in his schemes to terrorize and take over the world. She has a heavy German accent, and is well known for a running gag in which she shouts her orders needlessly loud and screeching, often startling Dr. Evil.
